newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH PX50 CLOSES UP LED AGAIN BY SPT TELECOM. [CORRECTED 15:35 GMT]
newsitem.headline: CZECH PX50 CLOSES UP LED AGAIN BY SPT TELECOM. [CORRECTED 15:35 GMT]

text.p: The Czech PX50 rose again on Thursday as SPT Telecom showed no sign of running out of steam and other major issues posted only small losses.

SPT jumped another 157 crowns, 3.7 percent, to 4,380 bringing its total gains in the week so far to 15 percent. Dealers said there were no new factors affecting SPT's performance apart from the solid first half earnings results it published last week.
"There is nothing more to say except that people should be cautious that profit taking might happen soon," said one local dealer.
Komercni Banka lost momentum after posting even stronger gains than SPT throughout the week. Komercni lost two crowns to 1,930.
Power utility CEZ declined two crowns to 919.
Some analysts say that CEZ, despite concerns about its short term prospects, still represents a good long term buy.

"At the start of the next century...CEZ will have completed its heavy investment programme and its solid cash-generating ability will make it highly attractive indeed," said Patrik Brom of Prague International Securities.
